metadata.title: Server Patch and Vulnerability Posture

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability evaluating server exposure to known vulnerabilities and missing security updates.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Server, workload, and platform execution technology domain.

props.name: technology-platform
props.remarks: Patch management systems, vulnerability scanners, and exposure assessment platforms.

props.name: architecture-pattern

props.name: data-entity
props.remarks: Patch status, vulnerability findings, CVE mappings, and exposure assessment results.

metadata.remarks:
Server Patch and Vulnerability Posture defines the capability to assess a server or workload’s exposure to known vulnerabilities and missing security updates. This pattern evaluates risk based on current intelligence and observable state. It does not itself enforce patching or remediation. Outputs inform change management, risk acceptance, and runtime defense decisions.

Governance and Responsibility Anchor:
This pattern is the authoritative anchor for SSPPs, standards, procedures, guidelines, and assurance related to server vulnerability awareness and patch posture. Controls are intentionally scoped to assessment and evaluation and exclude remediation and enforcement.

components.title: Patch Status Evaluation
components.description: Assessment of server operating system and software patch currency.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Exploitation of unpatched server software to gain elevated privileges.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Assessment and reporting of patch currency to identify exposure.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Identify missing security updates and patches on servers.

components.title: Vulnerability Identification
components.description: Identification of known vulnerabilities affecting server operating systems, platforms, and installed components.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Exploitation of servers with known, exposed vulnerabilities.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Identification of known weaknesses through systematic scanning.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Scan servers for known vulnerabilities using approved methodologies.

components.title: Exposure Analysis
components.description: Evaluation of exploitability and exposure based on server role, configuration, and connectivity.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Lateral or opportunistic exploitation based on exposed vulnerable services.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Contextual risk analysis to prioritize vulnerabilities by exploitability and impact.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Assess the risk posed by identified vulnerabilities in their operational context.

components.title: Posture Reporting

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Manipulation or suppression of vulnerability reporting to obscure risk.

props.name: defense-technique

implemented-requirements.remarks: Provide ongoing visibility into server vulnerability and patch posture.
